initialize_GlobalHydra: initialize the GlobalHydra singleton with a Hydra instance to configure the application
get_GlobalHydra_instance: get the GlobalHydra singleton instance using the static instance method
check_GlobalHydra_initialized: check if GlobalHydra is initialized by calling the is_initialized method
get_config_loader: get the ConfigLoader from the GlobalHydra singleton instance for loading configurations
clear_GlobalHydra: clear the GlobalHydra singleton instance to allow re-initialization with a new Hydra instance
